summary: The six GPU cells, request metrics, full work accounting, present-state actions, and KV-resource invariants are supported. No P0/P1 was found. Scope and noise permit only the reported MEASUREMENT_ONLY conclusion.

included: six actual GPU cells and adjacent logs
packaged execution, metric, telemetry, rotation, and capture code
analysis_r02.json and its declared analyzer dependencies
replacement-device launch, completion, readback, and release receipts
excluded: task-quality, HTTP/network, production, multi-GPU, and cross-device timing claims

trace_policy: No .aris trace created because the review task explicitly prohibited new .aris files.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: Pinned WikiText inputs feed actual native request execution. Timing, completion, action, and KV facts are directly observed. Output equality is explicitly limited to an execution-identity proxy and is not task quality.

B_score_normalization_and_accounting.details: No self-normalization was found. All arrived requests remain in the denominator. Independent raw recomputation matched request metrics, percentiles, wall time, six report rows, work conservation, and nested timing accounting.

C_result_file_and_number_existence.details: All six predeclared cells, raw/metrics/config/environment/status/headroom files, adjacent logs, terminal receipts, and nine comparisons exist. All reported numbers match. Old analysis_r01 remains historical UNRUN.
C_result_file_and_number_existence.nonblocking_note: safe-cap-qualification.json:3 retains the pre-measurement value NOT_YET_RUN while adjacent terminal status is COMPLETE; it is not used as terminal status.

D_dead_code_and_actual_action_path.details: Critical metric, capture, memory, and rotation functions are called. Every proposal replayed from policy-specific current state, every native preemption call/return reconciled, and live pool/request block conservation plus held-KV equality held. No future policy state was reused.

E_scope_independence_and_noise.details: One reused 32-document cohort and one execution per order position do not form independent workload repeats or a calibrated noise bound. Same-role throughput drift reaches 2.381 percent and overlaps the treatment-scale result. Within-group device/runtime/isolation receipts are consistent, and old-device timing is correctly excluded.

F_evaluation_type_and_claim_ceiling.details: The evidence supports a bounded single-device full-request systems result. It does not support semantic quality, significance, fresh-workload generalization, HTTP/network or production SLO, multi-GPU EP, cross-device timing, or an independent method contribution.

claims.claim: The six GPU cells completed with 192 request instances and the reported request/work metrics.
The funding filter changed actual present-state victim choices and native KV/preemption work.
The funding filter did not establish repeatable full-request improvement over least-progress in this group.
The funding filter is a generally beneficial or independent method contribution.
Old-device timing can be paired with this replacement-device run.
The appended structural model, lifecycle, or branch findings are accepted by this review.

claim_ceiling: Bounded descriptive result for one reused 32-document episode on one replacement RTX 5090 with pinned vLLM 0.26.0 and 6656 usable KV blocks.
next_smallest_experiment: Run the unchanged six-cell protocol once on a predeclared fresh document-disjoint 32-request cohort, on the same device/runtime/pool, with counterbalanced order and no threshold tuning. Require a same-sign full-request effect beyond observed same-role drift and retain most_output as the strong simple reference.
resurrection_condition: Continue the funding-filter performance hypothesis only after a fresh controlled cohort shows a stable full-request benefit beyond drift and competitive with most_output; otherwise do not generalize beyond the tested formulation/regime.
